title: False Alarm Fatigue: How Monitor Alert Frequency Affects Human Reviewer Decision Quality

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Alert fatigue is well-documented in other safety domains and will certainly affect AI monitoring. Establishing the threshold where human performance degrades directly informs false positive rate requirements for monitors.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing and running a user study requires IRB-equivalent approval processes, participant recruitment, and experimental design rigor. Even with CS student participants, the study design methodology is outside typical CS coursework.

narrow_scope.reasoning: User studies are notoriously time-consuming: design, recruitment, running sessions, and analysis. 10-15 participants at two conditions minimum. 30 hours is very tight for a user study, especially for beginners unfamiliar with the methodology.
